sentences.text: 2. When this Crl.MC came up for consideration on 07.10.2024, there was no representation for the petitioner.
There was representation on the side of the 2024:KER:75108 2nd respondent.
Today also, there is no representation for the petitioner and the 2nd respondent is represented through her counsel.

3. This Crl.MC is filed to quash the proceedings in Annexure-B. Annexure-B is the final report filed against the petitioner alleging offences punishable under Sections 406, 418, 120(B), 420 r/w 34 of IPC.
4.
After going through the final report, I am of the considered opinion that the contention of the petitioner is to be raised before the trial court at the appropriate stage.
If charge is not framed, the petitioner is free to file a discharge petition and if, such a discharge petition is filed, the learned Magistrate will consider the same, in accordance with law.
With the above observation, this Criminal Miscellaneous Case is disposed of.
